module: Flowgraph node 'Select Garage Sites' (once_instant category, author BeamNG). Picks a start spot in the mission's initial zones and an end spot in the destination zones (mission.initialZones and destinationZones, generated by mission:generateZoneLists if needed), from sitesData.parkingSpots. Avoids already used spots, enforces a distance between minDist and maxDist (otherwise takes the best candidate). Outputs: impulse 'loaded', startSpot, endSpot, startLocation, endLocation (zone names).
notes: The best candidate is the one whose (distance - maxDist) is the smallest, which can be a negative value (too close).
Spots are compared by name and marked as used in usedStartSpots / usedEndSpots.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the state, the used spots and the outputs.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the selection and the outputs to zero.

resetData.desc: Resets the selection, state=1 and the outputs to zero.

findEndSpotForStartingSpot.desc: Shuffles the possible end spots and returns the first one whose distance to the start spot is within [minDist, maxDist]; otherwise the one closest to maxDist from below (best candidate).

work.desc: state 1: computes the possible spots, empties the usage lists when exhausted, picks start and end, sorts the zones by prio, writes the outputs and loaded=true, goes to state 2. state 2: loaded=false.
